# Accepted capabilities

### capability-harborlog-configuration-cli
## TOML configuration CLI

Loads policy configuration from TOML, applies defaults and validation, and exposes a policy inspection command through the module entry point.

Claims:
- [claim-toml-cli-boundary](claims/p-f1d93709752c-002.md#claim-claim-toml-cli-boundary)
- [claim-standard-library-package](claims/p-cdb4ee2aea69-001.md#claim-claim-standard-library-package)

Evidence:
- file: src/harborlog/config.py:1-38
- file: src/harborlog/cli.py:1-35
- file: src/harborlog/\_\_main\_\_.py:1-6

### capability-harborlog-domain-modeling
## HarborLog inspection domain

Models immutable assets, findings, inspection requests and records, lifecycle statuses, risk assessments, and aggregate summaries.

Claims:

Evidence:

### capability-harborlog-input-safety
## Input normalization and validation

Canonicalizes identifiers and text, coerces severity, validates assets and inspection requests, and enforces lifecycle transition preconditions.

- file: src/harborlog/validation.py:1-69

### capability-harborlog-persistence
## Inspection repository and persistence

Provides a protocol-backed in-memory adapter and atomic JSONL adapter behind a repository that exposes domain-level lookup errors.

Claims:
- [claim-repository-and-stores](claims/p-f1d93709752c-001.md#claim-claim-repository-and-stores)
- [claim-atomic-jsonl-persistence](claims/p-f1d93709752c-001.md#claim-claim-atomic-jsonl-persistence)

Evidence:

### capability-harborlog-policy-lifecycle
## Inspection policy and lifecycle

Applies category due dates and open-age limits, then controls close and waive transitions through configurable policy checks.

Claims:
- [claim-configurable-policy](claims/p-f1d93709752c-001.md#claim-claim-configurable-policy)
- [claim-service-orchestration](claims/p-f1d93709752c-002.md#claim-claim-service-orchestration)

Evidence:
- file: src/harborlog/policy.py:1-43

### capability-harborlog-risk-views
## Risk, search, and reporting views

Scores findings and schedule state, filters inspections by common predicates, orders records newest first, and renders concise operator summaries and assessments.

Claims:
- [claim-risk-and-query-views](claims/p-f1d93709752c-002.md#claim-claim-risk-and-query-views)

Evidence:
- file: src/harborlog/scoring.py:1-48
- file: src/harborlog/reporting.py:1-22
